services.name: Spring League Sign Up
services.desc: The League Come join in the fun this spring with Battlefront League Play. Starting in February, 8 teams of 5 players will battle it out each week for 6 weeks to earn the title of CHAMPION. You can sign up a 10 person roster, but you will only field teams of 5 during the battle each week. It's always great to have some subs. We'll kick things off on Tuesday, 2/5 and Thursday, 2/7 and go through Tuesday, 3/19 and Thursday, 3/21. Tuesdays are for ages 13-17 Only Thursdays are reserved for 18+ Only We will start each weeks games at 4pm and play a series of games until dark for points.
